'''Karric Soik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he resided on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial-affiliated individual.

==Behind the scenes==
Karric Soik appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Dromund Kaas. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by any Imperial character for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
